thread:
support-sre: :rotating_light: Customer 'paperly' escalated — intermittent 5xxs and long timeouts on hosted API. p95 jumped from ~300ms to ~7s around 2026-03-17T14:12Z. Observed request queue depth >900 and continuous-batching backlog building.

maria.s: seeing it on per-tenant dashboard. ingress.queue_depth spikes to ~900, dequeue timeouts and batcher backpressure traces. No recent auth or billing changes.

kevin: alert fired: hosted.gateway.queue.depth > 800 (5m). ops-bot dropped alert: https://redwood.monitor/alerts/AL-8821

carmen: customer says requests are timing out with 504s. Any deploys in the window?

maria.s: no code deploys. I tried to reproduce with a focused longseq pattern — looks like continuous batching accumulates KV wait for long sequences. Repro curl (stress):
```
for i in {1..250}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"'$RANDOM'"}' & done
```

kevin: grabbing logs now. sample:
```
[14:15:02] dequeue_timeout tenant=paperly depth=912 p95=7.2s batcher_wait_ms=4200
[14:15:07] gateway_5xx tenant=paperly code=504 msg=\"request timeout\"
[14:15:10] enqueue tenant=paperly payload_size=1800 seq_len=2048
```

eli: quick mitigations we can apply: 1) soft throttle tenant to 120 rps 2) bump queue soft limit 800->1200 for 10m 3) route traffic to a smaller fallback model (quantized) to reduce token compute.

carmen: check runbook: https://confluence.redwood/queue-surge-runbook — recommends tenant throttle and temporary queue bump.

maria.s: applied soft bump to 1200 for 5m and enabled tenant throttle 120 rps. Monitoring: queue depth dropped to ~420 in 2m, p95 improved to ~650ms. Customer updated in PD ticket.

kevin: longer-term: we should reduce max_continuous_batch_size for longseq paths to avoid big KV waits. Also consider enforcing per-tenant batch caps.

eli: created MR for a conservative runtime change (reduce continuous batch size for seq_len>1024): gitlab.com/redwood/serving-runtime/-/merge_requests/432 — will canary to staging 2 pods.

deploy-bot: rollout started: MR 432 -> staging (canary 2 pods) by eli

support-sre: customer notified in PD-8810: "we throttled and applied a temporary queue bump; engineering is rolling a runtime change for sustained mitigation."

carmen: saved repro steps and load generator script to tickets/PD-8810/repro.md and flagged for postmortem.

maria.s: will monitor for 3h, then schedule a short postmortem if recurrence. Leaving channel open.

kevin: thanks — please add any follow-ups to INC-9921.

ops-bot: auto-note: incident INC-9921 created, severity P2.
